lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCu6(O3F)2 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 21 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Cu and Mg centers, with Cu octahedra surrounded by three F and three O neighbors and Mg octahedra coordinated by six O atoms. These octahedra share corners and edges in the observed periodic polyhedron contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 21 sites.
